[EN] Secure the Area
[ES] Asegurar el área
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Lock down the area around the Northern Teleport Platform.
[ES] Asegura el área alrededor de la plataforma de teletransporte norte.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We've got work to do.
[ES] Tenemos trabajo que hacer.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with {@LinkCreature:76#1034}.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Zariik Cyclops's Wing
[ES] Ala de Cíclope Zariik
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill zariik cyclopses around the {@LinkCreature:249#1102} and collect their wings.
[ES] Mata cíclopes zariik alrededor de {@Rgn:249#1102} y recoge sus alas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the wings to {@LinkCreature:76#1034}.
[ES] Entrega las alas a {@LinkCreature:76#1034}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I hope they're worth it."
[ES] "Espero que valgan la pena."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "You got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report back to {@LinkCreature:76#1024}.
[ES] Informa a {@LinkCreature:76#1024}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
